Definition: feminine of the same as G2457; Julia, a Christian woman:--Julia.
BiblicalUsage: Julia is one of the believers Paul greets at the end of his letter to Rome. In Romans 16:15 he says, salute Philologus, and Julia, and Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Julia's name in the greeting is the whole church in miniature: ordinary believers, named one by one, and called saints.
